Revelation: This is the order of the house prepared for the presidency of the school of the prophets, established for their instruction in all things that concern them, or, in other words, the officers in the church, beginning with the high priests to the deacons.

Verses.content: And also, the order of the house prepared for the presidency of the school of the prophets, established for their instruction in all things that concern them, or, in other words, the officers in the church, beginning with the high priests to the deacons.
And this is the order of the house: The one who shall be appointed president or teacher shall occupy his place in the house which will be prepared for him.
That he may be first in the house of God, from a place where the congregation that are in the house can hear his words attentively and distinctly without speaking in a loud voice.

And when one shall enter after him, let the master rise, and with hands stretched out directly towards heaven, salute his brother or brothers with these words: Are you brother, or are you brethren? I greet you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, as a remembrance of the everlasting covenant.
And if any be found unworthy of this salutation he shall not have place among you; for you will not permit him to profane my house.
And the one entering and faithful before me, and being brother, or brethren, salute him with the same blessing and covenant, or saying Amen, as a token of agreement.
And this is to be your order in saluting one another in the house of God, in the school of the prophets.

And it is given you for a rule, that you receive no man into this school until he be clean from the blood of this generation; and shall receive him by the ordinance of washing of the feet, because it was instituted for that end.
And the president or elder president of the church shall administer the ordinance of washing the feet.
He shall begin with prayer, and after partaking of bread and wine, he shall gird himself as a pattern given in the thirteenth chapter of John's testimony concerning me. Amen.
